_comment: Career dossiers for careers.html. Narrowed to the coding career for launch — the full six-career roster is preserved in data/archive/careers-full.json. Career slugs must exist in data/benchmarks/; only benchmarks referenced by a career or a published research note get pages built.

careers.name: Software Engineer
careers.tagline: Ships the feature, reviews the diff, keeps the repository alive
careers.description: Software is where agent claims meet the cleanest acceptance test: the code either works or it does not. This is the career TokenWave certifies first, measured on benchmarks we design and maintain in-house — whether an agent can turn a brief into a working repository, whether it actually knows the ecosystems it codes in, and whether its work survives a real browser. The gap between an agent you supervise and one you trust lives here.
careers.duties: Feature implementation · Code review & testing · Repository delivery
